title: Keresdi Bethlen cipher letters, 1645-1648, DECODE R4936-R4940, R4942 (R4941 and the Kemény records split off)

transcription.notes: Two surviving cipher expressions; deleted preceding word not counted. Both folios inspected; verso is address/seal.
All cipher transcribed 23 Oct 2026 (R4942-transcription.txt); p. 3 clear slip in R4942_slip.txt.
The three cipher spans on image P2 transcribed 23 Oct 2026 (r2h); the clear letter around them (P1-P4) not transcribed. Family hand; a later pencil gloss over the spans.

Transcribed letter by letter 23 Oct 2026 (r2h) from the DECODE images P1-P2 at 2-3x; 50 look-alike labels corrected on the crops (R4939_corrections.tsv). A different cipher and hand from the family of R4936/R4940.

system.summary: A Hungarian letter substitution: the alphabet family shared by R4936 and R4940 (c=p, p=c, g=u, q=t, v/w=a), with Hungarian fragments under it in R4937 and R4942. R4938 and R4939 are not yet inspected and are listed here only because they belong to the same Keresdi_Bethlen_15 series; no shared key is claimed for them.

conditions.human_role: Supplied target records in objective file.

solution.what: Downloaded 28 authenticated source images and text metadata for all ten DECODE records; no document attachments listed.
Provisional manual transcription of R4936 page 1 paragraphs 1-2, omitting clear words; R4936-p1-extract.txt.

50 deterministic annealing restarts with hu-modern quadgrams (attack.py); stable readable Hungarian at restart 2, including kiralynak, szandekaban, hadakozni, szomszedorszagokat; transcription errors remain.

Downloaded Lukinich 1907 correspondence part 1 and 1908 biography part 1 after first R4936 solver result. No exact cipher-letter match established. Search leads: Szilagyi 1873 Swedish/French diplomatic documents; Erdely es az eszakkeleti haboru vol.1.

Independent 50-restart hu-modern quadgram probes on R4937 and R4942 extracts yielded Hungarian fragments but wrong or transcription-confounded key assignments. R4941 quadgram and quintgram probes did not yield coherent reading.
Compared alphabetic extracts; shared-key-hypothesis.json records provisional family mapping, notably g=u, q=t, c=p, p=c, and v/w=a. R4936 extraction heavily confuses q/g.
Inspected both R4940 images. Two surviving cipher expressions read votumiok and niertdologvolna under sibling key; image confirms sender, recipient, date. R4940-reading.md and R4940-cipher.txt.
Measured R4940 cipher-only transcription with docs/_check_profile.py --measure --letters: 23 letters, 14 distinct.
noisy_probe.py proposes only penalized glyph-confusion corrections to provisional R4936 transcription; outputs are unverified hypotheses and not a completed reading.
Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 23 tokens, 14 types, hu-modern order 4: reading -2.835 per letter; Verdict: too short.

One-key review (Lasry's rule, 14 Oct 2026): the ten records of R4933-R4942 were grouped by DECODE number range. Split by system: this entry keeps the R4936/R4940 alphabet family (with R4937, R4942) and the uninspected R4938, R4939 of the same series (no key claimed); R4941 (a different substitution) is r4941; the Kemény_XIX_1628 records R4933-R4935 are kemeny1628.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): R4936, R4937, R4940 and R4942 linked to the existing provisional transcriptions/extracts and their mechanical or solver outputs (R4936-mechanical.txt, R4937/R4942 extract-result.json, R4940-reading.md). Missing: R4938 and R4939 were never transcribed; R4936, R4937 and R4942 have no checked full reading (target in progress)

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test): R4936-mechanical.txt (0 of 16 sentences clean, docs/_check_reading.py) and the R4937/R4942 solver outputs are letter streams without sentences; relabelled decoded, not read. R4940's two cipher spans read in their clear context (reviewed B). fraction_read set to ~0.008 (estimated, 23 of ~2,776 cipher letters).

Re-read (REREAD_BRIEF, b15): the DECODE records R4936, R4937, R4942 have no document attachments (Documents 0); all their images (2, 1, 4) opened at full resolution from the main checkout. R4942's image 3 is a clear slip carrying the text of the p. 2 cipher block (signed 'Sigis Rakoczi', annotated 'Bethlen F.'), not used before. R4936 has a later pencil gloss under its first cipher line only.

Print searched for the letters: Lukinich, Keresdi baro Bethlen Ferencz (Szazadok 1908, second instalment) describes the 1645 and 1646-47 Warsaw missions and cites the originals 'partly in cipher' in the Keresd archive, no decipherment; Szilagyi, A linzi beke okirattara (1885) and Erdely es az eszakkeleti haboru I (MEK) grepped: no edition of R4936/R4937/R4942.

R4936 re-transcribed line by line from 2.4-3x crops of both pages (R4936-transcription-b15.txt); 215 label changes against the provisional transcription (R4936_corrections.tsv), mostly g/q, c/e, i/n and dropped or doubled minims. R4937 transcribed in full (34 lines, 869 letters) and R4942's cipher in full (252 letters); one R4942 label corrected (R4942_corrections.tsv).

The family's reciprocal letter key (shared-key-hypothesis.json) applied unchanged to all three letters; R4937 and R4942 read at sight. R4936 read sentence by sentence with the look-alike pairs of the hand resolved by sense; R4937's hand confuses cipher l and r twice (hamis, ha szinte). Readings aligned letter by letter with the figures (b15_align.py): R4936 1,794 + 130 class-resolved of 1,932; R4937 839 + 3 of 847; R4942 236 + 6 of 249.

docs/_check_reading.py gives 0.03, 0.05 and 0.0 on the reading bodies, but also 0.07 and 0.0 on genuine printed Hungarian letters of 1645 (Szilagyi 1885): its modern 'hu' word list does not know 17th-c. spelling; with a period list from the 1640s prints added the controls reach 0.53-0.60 and the readings 0.05-0.25 (the cipher spelling: oe, cz, unaccented, run-on). Explicit holes only (b17_score.py HOLES=1): R4936 0.94 (32/34), R4937 0.90 (18/20), R4942 1.00 (4/4). All three set read, grade B, with that caveat.

Verify sweep (reading audit v2): R4936's look-alike letters checked. R4936_align.tsv: 130 letters on the other member of a pair (g=t 114, q=u 6, c=y 4, g=g 3, h/a/n 1 each), 6.7% of the reading. g- and q-shaped figures compared on IMG_R4936_I28640_P1 at 3x (lines 1-2, 4-5): not separable at the scan's resolution, no larger DECODE file, no contemporary or printed decipherment. Words carrying them counted as holes (research/reading_audit/v2_lookalike_holes.py, v2_score.py): 0.147 explicit-hole share against 0.941 as published. Demoted to decoded, not read; fraction_read re-measured.

r2h: R4938 (4 images) and R4939 (3 images) opened at full DECODE resolution (1,704 px); no documents, comments or associated records on either record. R4939 P3 is the clear address to Ferenc Bethlen and András Klobusiczky, envoys to the Polish election diet; its last page has a clear date (Alba, [?9] 1648) and two signatures. Print checked: Erdély és az északkeleti háború I prints the envoys' October 1648 reports, not this letter.
r2h: the family key (shared-key-hypothesis.json) tried on R4939's first page: no Hungarian; R4939 is a different alphabet and hand.

r2h: R4939 transcribed letter by letter (R4939-transcription.txt, 1,631 letters) and broken ciphertext-only by injective annealing with word divisions (research/reading_audit/r2h_r4939_anneal.py, hu-modern 5-gram, 10 restarts): 'kivantuk volna ... oervendeteseb hirt irhattunc volna kegyelmeteknek az mi kegyelmes urunknac ...' at restart 1. Key R4939_key.md.

r2h: 50 look-alike labels corrected on 3x crops (q/g, r/t/s/x; R4939_corrections.tsv); reading R4939_reading.md and English R4939_en.md aligned word by word with the decode; 16 of 1,449 letters (1.1%) on look-alike alternates; v2_score explicit holes 0.75 (18/24). The father György I Rákóczi dying, Zsigmond's Polish candidacy to be promoted. Read, grade B.

r2h: R4938's three cipher spans (54 letters, image P2) transcribed and decoded with the family key unchanged: 'az Rakoczi Sigmon', 'az nekunk [...] volna', 'mi [?nevunkre] forogion'; a later pencil gloss agrees. Phrase fragments, one word unread (too-short): decoded, not read. Neither record settles R4936's g/q look-alikes.

Independent second reader (sr) on R4939: 6 cipher lines drawn with random.seed(4939) (16, 17, 24, 29, 32, 45; lines 1-12 excluded as already seen), transcribed blind on 2-3x crops of IMG_R4939_I28645_P1/P2, decoded with R4939_key.md and compared with R4939-transcription.txt and R4939_reading.md (R4939_sr_blind.tsv). Letters 200/213 agree (93.9%); reading words not carried 8/36 blind, 3/36 (8.3%) after re-crops (bizoeta-, azekatru-, kegylme). Key checked: one cipher letter one plain letter, 23 distinct values, ten reciprocal pairs; the decode reads as 1648 Hungarian by sense.

R4940: the clear Hungarian letter around the two cipher spans transcribed for the first time from IMG_R4940_I28653_P1.jpg on 1.5x line crops (raised-dot e, kegyelmed abbreviations written out); R4940_reading.md and English R4940_en.md. The cipher spans are unchanged (votumiok; niert dolog volna) and fit the clear sentence: if their votes were as Your Grace writes, it would be a won matter. Opening sentence partly doubtful (Foldvari [?Mihaly] ... [?erkezven]); one word near the end unread.
Consistency pass (cl): documents[].read for R4936 read -> read in part, matching outcome.texts (decoded, not read) and fraction_read_source.
Read bar applied per document (v10): 3 of 4 documents marked read measure under 95% of words read as sense (v2_score explicit holes) and are now read in part; read_share recorded for each.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.835; polyphony 0.0; 0 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached n/a

outcome.notes: In progress: R4940 cipher expressions read, others unverified or untranscribed. No group completion or novelty claim. R4941 and R4933-R4935 split off 14 Oct 2026. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: R4936, R4937, R4942 relabelled decoded, not read; only R4940's two spans read. 23 Oct 2026, re-read (b15): R4936, R4937 and R4942 transcribed in full from the images and read with the family key unchanged (readings, English and letter alignments in the folder); R4942's image 3 is a clear slip of the same text. R4938 (clear with short cipher insertions) and R4939 (two pages of cipher in a different-looking script) still not transcribed. 23 Oct 2026, verify sweep v2: R4936 back to decoded, not read (6.7% of its letters on look-alike alternates the scan cannot settle); R4937, R4942 and R4940 stay read. 23 Oct 2026 (r2h): R4939 broken ciphertext-only (its own key) and read; R4938 spans decoded with the family key; neither settles R4936's g/q.
outcome.method_basis: Hungarian letter substitution recovered by quadgram annealing on R4936 (hu-modern model); R4940 cipher spans (23 letters) read with the shared alphabet family; R4936, R4937 and R4942 transcribed in full and read with the same key on 23 Oct 2026 (R4942 also has a clear slip of its cipher block); R4939 (a different simple substitution, another hand) broken ciphertext-only by annealing and read on 23 Oct 2026; R4938's three spans decoded with the family key unchanged.

texts.label: R4936, 1645 (provisional)
texts.summary: Numbered instructions in the prince's 'we' to Ferenc Bethlen at Warsaw, 1645, with clear Hungarian links: the King must be persuaded and the Respublica should not disgrace itself or bow to the Turk; the King is asked to hire 3,000 musketeers and 1,000 dragoons (at least 2,000 and 1,000) for Transylvania; money at Danzig; recruits to Munkacs and Makovica; news of Bregy and Croissy.
texts.note: Verify sweep 23 Oct 2026 (reading audit v2): back to decoded, not read. The b15 reading (R4936_reading.md, kept as a partial reading) puts 130 of its 1,932 letters (6.7%, in 99 of 338 words; 114 are t read on a figure labelled g, whose own value is u) on the other member of a look-alike pair; the brief's limit is about 3% unless a contemporary or printed text confirms them, and none exists (only a later pencil gloss under line 1). Checked on the DECODE image IMG_R4936_I28640_P1 at 3x: the g- and q-shaped figures do not separate at the scan's 1,704-px resolution, so the choices rest on sense. Scores: explicit holes 0.941 (32/34) as published; 0.147 (5/34) with the look-alike words counted as holes; 0.029 plain (modern hu word list). Blocker: illegible (scan resolution; a better image of Keresdi_Bethlen_14 would settle g/q).

texts.label: R4937, 1646 (partial extract)
texts.summary: 1646, to 'edes Hokmester' (Bethlen): the Emperor will effect nothing of the diploma for the Evangelicals; the clergy rules him; keep secret from the King why Transylvania would not join a war on the Turk; hire 4,000 foot with officers, or 2,000 armed men, or at least 1,000 foot and 500 dragoons.

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b15) from a full transcription of the one page (R4937-transcription.txt, 34 lines; the old extract had 25 and solver output only) with the family key unchanged; aligned (R4937_align.tsv): 847 letters, 839 on the figure's own value, 3 class-resolved, 4 inside [?words], 1 supplied. On the Emperor's diploma and the Evangelicals, keeping out of the King's war with the Turk, hiring 4,000 foot or 2,000 armed men. docs/_check_reading.py cannot score this Hungarian: its 'hu' word list (modern Gutenberg) gives genuine printed 1645 letters from Szilagyi's Linz edition 0.07 and 0.0, and this reading 0.05; explicit holes only (b17_score.py HOLES=1) give 0.90 (18 of 20 sentences). Open: the run after 'megsegni' (l. 3) and the end of l. 13.

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 93.3% of the words of R4937_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

texts.label: R4940, Rákóczi Zsigmond to Ferenc Bethlen, Munkács, 2 Aug 1648
texts.summary: A clear letter with two short cipher spans, read 'votumiok' (their votes) and 'niert dolog volna' (it would be a won matter) with the shared alphabet family.

reading_review.note: Translation wave v9, 23 Oct 2026: the clear letter around the two cipher spans was transcribed from IMG_R4940_I28653_P1.jpg (R4940_reading.md); v2_score.py hu: explicit holes 0.667 (6/9), plain 0.222 (the Hungarian word list does not know 1648 spelling), hole rate 0.115. Both cipher spans (votumiok, niert dolog volna) sit in a sentence that holds ('Ha a dolognak votumiok ugy volna, az mint irja kegyelmed, niert dolog volna'); the weak sentence is the clear opening (Foldvari ... erkezven), doubtful in the hand, not in the cipher.

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 88.7% of the words of R4940_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

texts.label: R4942, Zsigmond Rakoczi to Ferenc Bethlen, 1648 (cipher block of p. 2 and two words)
texts.summary: Zsigmond Rakoczi, 1648: Bethlen's goodwill has reassured him though there is almost no hope for the present affair; the intermediaries must be used; his brother is so disposed with the plenipotentiary power that he can promise more. The p. 3 slip gives the same text in clear.

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b15): every cipher passage transcribed (R4942-transcription.txt: the 7-line block at the head of p. 2 and two words lower down), decoded with the family key and aligned (R4942_align.tsv: 249 letters, 236 on their own value); the DECODE record's image 3 is a clear slip with the same words, signed 'Sigis Rakoczi' and noted by Bethlen (R4942_slip.txt), so the reading also rests on a contemporary clear text. docs/_check_reading.py cannot score this Hungarian: its 'hu' word list (modern Gutenberg) gives genuine printed 1645 letters from Szilagyi's Linz edition 0.07 and 0.0, and this reading 0.0; explicit holes only (b17_score.py HOLES=1) give 1.00 (4 of 4 sentences). Open: [?teliessegel] (one figure).

texts.label: R4939, the Rákóczi brothers to Ferenc Bethlen and András Klobusiczky at the Polish election diet, Alba, [?9 Oct] 1648
texts.summary: György I Rákóczi is dying; he had not sought the Polish crown for himself; the sons will not risk Transylvania by seeking the principality for Zsigmond now and bind the envoys to promote Zsigmond's candidacy for the Polish crown, spending money on it; letters will follow at the father's death. A different simple substitution from the family key, recovered ciphertext-only.

reading_review.note: R4939_reading.md: key recovered ciphertext-only (R4939_key.md, annealing with hu-modern on the first-pass transcription), 50 look-alike labels corrected on 3x crops (q/g, r/t/s/x), reading aligned word by word with the decode of the corrected labels; 16 of 1,449 letters (1.1%) still rest on a look-alike alternate by sense; words not carried bracketed. v2_score explicit holes 0.75 (18/24), plain 0.0 (modern word list; period spelling). Lines 03-09 keep unread groups; from line 10 the sentences hold. Second reader (sr, 23 Oct 2026, R4939_sr_blind.tsv): 6 random lines (seed 4939: 16, 17, 24, 29, 32, 45) transcribed blind from the DECODE scans: letters agree 200/213 (93.9%; 5 of the 13 differences the q/g pair); of 36 reading words 8 (22%) not carried by the blind decode, 3 (8.3%) after re-cropping the disputed letters (bizoeta-, azekatru- where sr sees ÿ, kegylme where the scan has kegyelme). The key is a consistent simple substitution (23 cipher letters, 23 distinct values) and mostly reciprocal (a-m, b-i, c-p, d-u, e-g, f-v, h-l, o-y, r-z, s-t), which confirms it independently of the annealer; the decoded lines are Hungarian of the period by sense (ra vetni nem akariuc az porta alapattia miben legyen tudhattia kegyelmetek). Kept read, grade B.

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 89.6% of the words of R4939_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

texts.label: R4938, G. Rákóczi to Ferenc Bethlen, 24 Apr 1647 (three cipher spans in a clear letter)
texts.summary: Three short cipher spans (54 letters) in a clear letter, decoded with the family key unchanged: 'az Rakoczi Sigmon', 'az nekunk [...] volna', 'mi [?nevunkre] forogion'; a later pencil gloss agrees.
texts.note: 23 Oct 2026 (r2h): the spans decode with the family key unchanged (h/k look-alike chosen by the word, 2 letters) and agree with a later pencil gloss, but they are phrase fragments of a clear letter not transcribed here; one word ('ailunkker') unread, occurring once (too-short). Not counted as a reading.
